actual_changes: Added watcher-observed, content-sensitive finalization recovery for the exact authorized fingerprint.
Added a fixed watcher-owned recovery prompt limited to validation, handoff, commit, and push completion.
Changed controller presentation precedence to RUNNING, COMPLETED, BACKOFF, BLOCKED, READY and added RUNNING FOR.
Reworked synthetic watcher/controller tests around isolated Git repositories; no business task was executed.
finalization_eligibility_rule: Recovery is eligible only when the same authorized fingerprint was launched from a recorded clean baseline; no matching completed handoff exists; the watcher recorded a non-empty dirty snapshot immediately after exit 0; current HEAD equals the observed post-run HEAD; and current dirty entries exactly equal the persisted status, path, and SHA-256 snapshot. Pre-existing, unknown, added, removed, renamed, content-changed, or different-fingerprint state blocks. Explicitly retryable recovery attempts retain the same proof and obey backoff/cap.
fixed_recovery_prompt_behavior: Reads AGENTS.md and current task; inspects exact dirty changes; stops on unrelated or ambiguous files; preserves valid existing work without redoing analysis; completes only missing validation/handoff/commit/push; names the full Git for Windows path; requires a clean final tree; stops after the phase. No task prose becomes shell input or commands.
controller_state_precedence: retry limit or unsafe state => BLOCKED
critical_boundaries_preserved: First launch still requires a clean worktree.
Workspace-write sandbox and on-request approval unchanged.
One-shot process and watcher lock behavior unchanged.
AUTO starts OFF; five-minute polling, no service/scheduler/startup/admin/WakeToRun changes.
Log cap remains approximately 4 MiB total.
No migration 009, database, schema, data, image, semantic, or P2A-3F0 content changed.
tests_or_checks: No real Codex business task executed
resource_impact_delta: Negligible: small git-status/hash checks during one-shot watcher cycles and the existing controller timer only; no new resident process or polling.
remaining_edge_cases: A recovery that cleans the tree but exits without a matching completed handoff remains unverified and follows the existing retry/block path.
File hashing cost scales with the size of dirty regular files, but runs only for a non-empty candidate snapshot.
next_minimum_action: Review this handoff. Do not start migration 009 or any business phase automatically.
